tools.name: project_population
tools.description: Projects future population size using exponential growth formula with a constant annual growth rate (percentage). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_electric_field
tools.description: Calculates the electric field strength produced by a point charge at a given distance using Coulomb's law: E = kQ/r². Uses permittivity parameter or defaults to vacuum permittivity. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_cell_density
tools.description: Calculates cell density (cells per mL) from optical density (OD) measurement and dilution factor. Formula: OD × dilution × factor (default 1e9 cells/mL per OD unit, organism-dependent). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_bacterial_growth
tools.description: Calculates bacterial population after a given time using exponential growth formula: N(t) = N₀ × e^(rt) or N(t) = N₀ × 2^(t/doubling_time). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_final_velocity
tools.description: Calculates final velocity using the kinematic equation: v = v₀ + at, where v₀ is initial velocity, a is acceleration, and t is time. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: potential_energy
tools.description: Calculates electrostatic potential energy using the formula U = qV, where U is energy, q is charge, and V is voltage. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: wire_resistance
tools.description: Calculates electrical resistance of a wire using the formula R = ρL/A, where R is resistance, ρ is material resistivity, L is length, and A is cross-sectional area. (cost: 1 credit)
